rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for an undergraduate higher-education college.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 duk6 gan2 daai6 zyun1

rows.note: Use this for a named faculty or specialized division within a university.

example.english: I’m studying at the medical college of a university.
example.jyutping: ngo5 duk6 gan2 daai6 hok6 ge3 ji1 hok6 jyun2

rows.note: Use this for a semi-autonomous Oxford- or Cambridge-style college.

example.english: I live in a college at Cambridge University.
example.traditional: 我住喺劍橋大學嘅一間書院。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 gim3 kiu4 daai6 hok6 ge3 jat1 gaan1 syu1 jyun2

rows.note: Use this when “college” means an association or professional body rather than an educational institution.

example.english: I’m a member of this professional college.
example.traditional: 我係呢個專業學會嘅會員。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 ni1 go3 zyun1 jip6 hok6 wui2 ge3 wui5 jyun4
